The '''Anobis system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Bright Jewel sector/Legends|Bright Jewel sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Anobis]].
